definition: A technique for applying the visual or stylistic characteristics of one piece of content (such as an artistic style) to another piece of content while preserving its underlying structure or content.
details: Style transfer, originally popularized in the context of neural image style transfer, has since been extended to other modalities like text style transfer, changing tone or formality while preserving underlying meaning.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. In plain words: A technique for applying the visual or stylistic characteristics of one piece of content (such as an artistic style) to another piece of content while preserving its underlying structure or content. Here is how it actually plays out: Style transfer, originally popularized in the context of neural image style transfer, has since been extended to other modalities like text style transfer, changing tone or formality while preserving underlying meaning. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Style Transfer.
